description_en: Sets or purges the AD server information for a gateway
description_zh: 为网关设置或清除AD服务器信息
name: SetGatewayADInfo

parameters.help_en:
The username that is used to connect to the AD server. Valid values:

If IsEnabled is set to false, you can leave this parameter empty.
If IsEnabled is set to true, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
连接AD服务器的用户名。可能值：

enabled为false，请忽略该字段。

enabled为true，该字段必传
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The password that is used to connect to the AD server. Valid values:

If IsEnabled is set to false, you can leave this parameter empty.
If IsEnabled is set to true, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
连接AD服务器的密码。可能值：

enabled为false，请忽略该字段。

enabled为true，该字段必传
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the AD server. Valid values:

If IsEnabled is set to false, you can leave this parameter empty.
If IsEnabled is set to true, this parameter is required. You must enter a valid IP address that consists of digits and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh:
AD服务器的IP。可能值：
enabled为false，请忽略该字段。

enabled为true，该字段必传，并输入有效的IP，只能由数字和半角句号（.）组成
parameters.name: server_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the AD server. Valid values:

true: enables the AD server.
false (default): purges the AD server information.

<notice>

If you want to enable the AD server, all parameters are required.
If you want to disable the AD server, you only need to set IsEnabled to false.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设置AD服务器的开关。可能值：

true：设置AD服务器信息。

false（默认）：清理AD服务器信息。

<notice>

需要开启AD时，所有参数都必填。
需要关闭AD时，只需要指定IsEnabled为false即可。

</notice>
parameters.name: is_enabled

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
